summary: Serve anonymized daily and trend stats
description: GET /stats/daily and GET /stats/trend. FR-C3-03, FR-C3-04, FR-C3-05, and FR-C3-06. Groups under min_group_size are omitted. Responses never contain user ids or hashes.
scope: Daily aggregates for requests, tokens, average prompt tokens, share above threshold, tokens saved, active users
Trend adds a 7-day average and a before/after baseline flag
Hide days with fewer than 5 distinct user hashes
acceptanceCriteria: Five users on 2026-10-05 with prompt 10 and completion 5 produce requests 5, total_tokens 75, avg_prompt_tokens 10.0, share_above_threshold 0.0, tokens_saved_est 0, active_users 5. Four users produce an empty days list, hidden_groups 1, and hidden_reason minimum group size. The response text does not contain the stored hash. Trend marks dates before the baseline as before and on or after it as after. FR-C3-03 FR-C3-04 FR-C3-05 FR-C3-06.
constraints: Do not return user_id or user_id_hash.
Do not show a per-user breakdown.
Do not include a day with fewer than config.min_group_size distinct hashes.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. Do not implement later CTX tasks early.
Every test function for this task's subtasks must contain that slice token, for example CTX_008_1.
After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command before ending the turn. Do not stop with explanation text only.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because earlier work implemented it correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
Keep edits inside targetArtifacts unless the subtask explicitly says otherwise.
When writing tests, assert only the current subtask's scope so later subtasks still have meaningful work.

businessRules: share_above_threshold counts stored events whose context_pct is >= config.compact_threshold, divided by requests.
rolling_7_day_avg_total_tokens averages total_tokens of visible days in the 7-day window ending that day.
baseline before when date < baseline query param, otherwise after.
The same API key rules as POST /events apply. Query org_id must match the key.
